posts.body:
OPM published a final rule Friday scrapping the 52-week time-in-grade requirement that kept federal employees at a grade for a year before promotion, [per Bloomberg Law](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/daily-labor-report/trump-personnel-office-removes-minimum-tenure-for-federal-hires).

posts.title: 60 weekly sets built no more muscle than 40
posts.excerpt: In the Finnish trial, 27 trained athletes who pushed leg training to about 60 weekly sets gained no significant extra muscle or strength over the group holding near 40, with deadlift gains actually…
posts.body: In the [Finnish trial](https://macrosmeasure.com/blog/is-there-a-ceiling-on-training-volume-what-the-63-sets-a-week-study-says-about-more-is-better), 27 trained athletes who pushed leg training to about 60 weekly sets gained no significant extra muscle or strength over the group holding near 40, with deadlift gains actually favoring the lower-volume group, 6.3% versus 4.3%. A separate October systematic review found volume load (sets × reps × weight) the variable most consistently tied to hypertrophy: progressive overload is the engine, and extra sets past the productive zone mostly add fatigue.

posts.title: 51 lawmakers urge agencies to reverse fast-track child deportations
posts.excerpt: Representative Andrea Salinas of Oregon and Senator Ron Wyden of Oregon led 51 members of Congress in an October 16 letter to the Justice Department, the Executive Office for Immigration Review, ICE,…
posts.body: Representative Andrea Salinas of Oregon and Senator Ron Wyden of Oregon led 51 members of Congress in an October 16 letter to the Justice Department, the Executive Office for Immigration Review, ICE, and USCIS urging the administration to "immediately reverse course" on accelerated deportation proceedings for unaccompanied children, citing 24-hour asylum-interview notices, large "mega master" hearings, limits on continuances, and reduced access to lawyers, per [VisaVerge's writeup](https://www.visaverge.com/legal/andrea-salinas-ron-wyden-lead-lawmakers-in-letter-on-unaccompanied-children-deportations/). The letter demands answers to 25 questions by October 30, 2026, with the Acacia Center for Justice endorsing it and a full public copy included, per the [press-release mirror](https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Press%20Release:%20Andrea%20Salinas%20and%20Ron%20Wyden%20Lead%20Lawmakers%20in%20Letter%20on%20Unaccompanied%20Children%20Deportations); it is oversight pressure rather than a remedy, and it stands apart from the legal-service providers' October 15 lawsuit covered earlier on this feed.

posts.body: Published Oct 16, 2026, 12:55 PM: AMD has [raised suggested prices across its entire Radeon RX 9000 lineup](https://www.eteknix.com/amd-officially-raises-radeon-rx-9000-prices-by-up-to-20/) for the third quarter of 2026. The RX 9070 XT takes the biggest hit, jumping from $830 to over $1,000.

posts.title: Sony locks jailbroken PS5s out of PSN unless they update to 14.10
posts.excerpt: Published Oct 16, 2026, 12:05 PM: Jailbroken PS5 owners now face a hard choice: stay on older firmware and lose PSN entirely, or update to 14.10 and lose the jailbreak, since Sony now demands the new…
posts.body: Published Oct 16, 2026, 12:05 PM: Jailbroken PS5 owners now face a hard choice: stay on older firmware and lose PSN entirely, or update to 14.10 and lose the jailbreak, since Sony now demands the new firmware for sign-in, [per Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Sony-blocks-PS5-console-jailbreak-from-PSN-requiring-firmware-update-14-10.1424308.0.html). The squeeze tightens next month, because data miners found GTA 6 will require 14.10 at launch even though it is single-player oriented.

posts.title: Strength only helps runners who actually stick with it
posts.excerpt: Published Oct 16, 2026, 11:20 AM: A 25-study meta-analysis of 26,610 athletes found strength programs cut sports injuries by more than 60%, though a runner-specific review found the benefit only held…
posts.body: Published Oct 16, 2026, 11:20 AM: A 25-study meta-analysis of 26,610 athletes found strength programs cut sports injuries by more than 60%, though a runner-specific review found the benefit only held in supervised high-adherence groups, [per MedicalXpress](https://medicalxpress.com/news/2026-10-runners-injuries-strength-difference.html?deviceType=mobile). The Oct 9 piece prescribes calf raises, split squats, squats and deadlifts at heavy loads for 5-6 reps plus plyometrics like pogo hops, which improve running economy even when injury risk barely moves.

posts.title: Three convicted in murders of Australian surfers in Mexico
posts.excerpt: Published Oct 16, 2026, 10:35 AM: Prosecutors are seeking 210 years each for the three men convicted in the Baja California surf-trip murders, who face sentencing today in Ensenada. Judge Raúl…
posts.body: Published Oct 16, 2026, 10:35 AM: Prosecutors are seeking 210 years each for the three men convicted in the Baja California surf-trip murders, who face sentencing today in Ensenada. Judge Raúl Hernández convicted Jesús Gerardo García, known as “El Kekas,” Irineo Francisco, and Ángel Jesús last week of murdering brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their American friend Carter Redd Rhoad at a Baja campsite in April 2024, [per The Trent](https://www.thetrentonline.com/three-convicted-of-murdering-australian-surfers-in-mexico/).

posts.title: Meta's 816B open-weight model debuts across seven clouds
posts.excerpt: Published Oct 16, 2026, 9:00 AM: Meta released Muse Spark Open on October 15, an 816-billion-parameter open-weight model built for coding and agentic work. Rather than a quiet weights drop, it…
posts.body: Published Oct 16, 2026, 9:00 AM: Meta [released Muse Spark Open](https://tech-insider.org/meta-muse-spark-open-seven-clouds-launch-2026/) on October 15, an 816-billion-parameter open-weight model built for coding and agentic work. Rather than a quiet weights drop, it launched with live APIs on seven providers and downloadable weights on four major hosts.
